title: Man of Sorrows
lyrics_original: Man of Sorrows, what a Name,
For the Son of God, Who came
In my place condemned He stood;
Sealed my pardon with His blood.
Spotless Lamb of God was He;
Lifted up was He to die;
When He comes, our glorious King,
All His ransomed home to bring,
Then anew His song we'll sing:

bible_verses.english: He was despised, and rejected by men; a man of suffering, and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.
For him who knew nothing about sin, he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for taking on my grief and standing in my place when I was helpless. When I am tempted to carry the burden of my past mistakes, remind me that Your blood has sealed my complete pardon. Help me walk today in the light of Your boundless mercy, singing of Your grace with every breath. You are my spotless Lamb and my glorious Savior. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Jesus willingly took on the title "Man of Sorrows" to trade His spotless righteousness for our deepest brokenness. On the cross, He stood in our place, quietly bearing our shame so that we could receive full pardon and unconditional grace. As we sing these powerful words, we are invited to lay down our guilt and rest completely in His finished work. What a wonder it is that the Lord of glory became a suffering Savior just to bring us home.
